Move my lives
1 in 8 Billion has no login: your lives are kept in this browser only, so another app or a new phone starts empty. One code moves them over as they are.

Bring lives from elsewhere
Type the code made in another browser or on another phone. Those lives are added to the ones in this browser.
Moving code
Bring them

Open this link where the lives should go, or type the code in 'Move my lives' at the bottom of the first screen there. It works once, for 3 days, so do not send it to anyone else. The lives also stay in this browser.
For a new phone, paste the link into a note or a message to yourself, then open it on the new phone.
